kind.description:
Kind is "failure" (a run that failed, needs a sign-in, or was skipped
or missed), "app" (about the app, e.g. an update) or "acknowledge" (a
routine's or hook's, through a plugin, waiting to be acknowledged).

routine.description: Routine and Run (a run ID, as in `runs show`) are what it's about, if any.

hook.description: Hook is true when Routine names a hook, not a routine.

urgent.description:
Urgent breaks through focus modes where the OS allows (macOS
time-sensitive, Linux critical urgency).

deliveredAt.description: DeliveredAt is when a frontend showed it; absent until then.

acknowledge.description:
Acknowledge is true when it waits for me to acknowledge it (kind
acknowledge): frontends show it with an Acknowledge action that runs
`notifications ack <id>`, and health is error until then.

acknowledgedAt.description: AcknowledgedAt is when I acknowledged it; absent while it waits.

items.description: Notification is one thing to tell me.

title: procauto notifications ack --json
description: AckOutput is `notifications ack --json`: the notifications acknowledged (none for ones acknowledged already).
